_note: Water zone. The source is at the bottom and the people are above it, so every drop costs power proportional to lift height — which quietly makes vertical layout an economic decision. Greywater returns downward free by gravity.

buildings.name: Deep pump
buildings._note: Highest wear rate in the game. It runs constantly and it is at the bottom of the Shaft, where the water is.

buildings.name: Purifier
buildings._note: Cleans the reclaimed water on the mains it is piped into; pumped groundwater needs no help.

buildings.name: Reclamation plant
buildings._note: Recovers the greywater the sewer drains bring it, at water.reclamationEfficiency, into whatever water mains it is piped to. Without it, every litre must be pumped fresh from the bottom.

buildings.name: Cistern
buildings._note: The hub of the water mains: it stores water and supplies every room and resident within serviceRadiusLevels, and what they use drains back into it for the sewer. Free to run, which makes it the cheapest insurance in the game and the easiest thing to forget to build.
